channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Caiado promete usar o Exército contra facções se for eleito presidente
item.description: PSD pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado promised to deploy the Army against criminal factions if elected president. However, he acknowledged that only 33% of the population currently knows him, posing a significant challenge to his campaign.

item.title: Zema se diz decepcionado com Flávio, mas prega união no 2º turno
item.description: Romeu Zema, pre-candidate for president and former governor of Minas Gerais, said he is disappointed with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over allegations that the senator received R$ 61 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse', calling the relationship 'imperdoável'. Despite criticizing the episode, Zema stated it is a 'closed chapter' and signaled a potential alliance with the bolsonarist bloc in the 2026 election runoff to defeat the left and the PT.

item.title: Zema ventila nome do Novo para vice na chapa de Mateus Simões em MG
item.description: At a Novo Party event in Belo Horizonte, city councilwoman Fernanda Altoé was floated as a potential running mate for Mateus Simões (PSD) in the 2026 gubernatorial race, with former governor Romeu Zema mentioning her support. She expressed readiness for the role and confirmed her pre-candidacy for state deputy under Novo. Former federal deputy Tiago Mitraud also made himself available to the party for any needed position.

item.title: Joaquim Barbosa será candidato ao Planalto em 2026, diz presidente do DC
item.description: Former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa will be the pre-candidate for president of Brazil in 2026 for the Christian Democracy (DC) party, as confirmed by party president João Caldas. This replaces the earlier pre-candidacy of Aldo Rebelo, who showed weak polling performance. Barbosa, previously considered by the PSB in 2018 and 2022, is notable for his role as rapporteur in the Mensalão trial.

item.title: Flávio usa caso de criança com doença rara para atacar Anvisa. Veja vídeo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro used the case of a child with Duchenne muscular dystrophy to criticize Anvisa during an event in Sorocaba, claiming the agency delays approval of essential medications. The child’s mother stated the treatment costs R$17 million and that Anvisa remains unresponsive, causing daily muscle loss in her son. This comes after Anvisa temporarily suspended Elevidys in July 2025 due to risks of acute hepatic failure.

item.title: Carlos diz que discutiu nomes ao Senado com Bolsonaro
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro stated he discussed potential Senate candidates with former President Jair Bolsonaro during a two-hour meeting in Brasília, as determined by Alexandre de Moraes. He said the trip aimed to fulfill filial duties and convey supporter support, while updating his father’s health status following shoulder surgery, with rehabilitation expected to last 6 to 9 months. Carlos described Jair Bolsonaro as a 'politically persecuted' figure subjected to daily torture and cut off from external communication, emphasizing bolsonarist articulations for 2026 in Santa Catarina and São Paulo.

item.title: Caiado: Se eleito, farei parceria com governadores para combater crime organizado
item.description: PSD presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado stated that, if elected, he would work directly with governors to combat organized crime and strengthen border control. He emphasized the need for a coordinated approach between the federal government and states to address public security challenges.

item.title: Derrite sai em defesa de Flávio: 'Acharam que tinham uma bomba atômica'
item.description: Federal deputy Guilherme Derrite (PP-SP) defended Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) during the launch of his pre-candidacy for the São Paulo Senate, stating that the episode involving the money request to banker Daniel Vorcaro is a 'closed page'. He claimed his opponents thought they had an 'atomic bomb' against the senator, but the matter has already been overcome. Both politicians were together in Sorocaba this Saturday.

item.title: José Dirceu mantém pré-candidatura após diagnóstico de linfoma
item.description: Former minister José Dirceu (PT-SP) reaffirmed his pre-candidacy for federal deputy following a lymphoma diagnosis, announcing he has begun chemotherapy and intends to continue his political campaign to re-elect Lula and support Fernando Haddad as governor of São Paulo and Simone Tebet for the Senate.

item.title: Lula está com o diabo e nós estamos com Deus, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he intends to maintain his 2026 presidential candidacy, claiming he is being persecuted. He commented on recent revelations about his relationship with former banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master during a political event in Sorocaba, São Paulo. The lawmaker also repeated the controversial phrase 'Lula is with the devil and we are with God'.

item.title: Como uma deputada do PT aparece no roteiro no filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: The film Dark Horse, depicting Jair Bolsonaro's trajectory, includes a scene based on the 2014 incident in which he insulted deputy Maria do Rosário (PT-RS), saying she 'does not deserve' to be raped because she is 'too bad' and 'too ugly'. In the fiction, she is named Glória and interrupts Bolsonaro's interview, shouting 'And you? Are you a rapist!', to which he responds that he is not a rapist and, if he were, he would not rape her. The scene ends with Eduardo Bolsonaro intervening to separate them.

item.title: Joaquim Barbosa se filia ao Democracia Cristã e deve disputar Planalto
item.description: Retired Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa joined the Christian Democracy party in April and is expected to run for president in 2026, replacing Aldo Rebelo as the party's pre-candidate. Party president João Caldas stated the change was 'impersonal and partisan' and that Barbosa has already been launched as a pre-candidate, with full autonomy to set his agenda. Barbosa, 71, gained prominence for presiding over the STF and reporting the Mensalão trial, and was named one of the 100 most influential people by Time magazine in 2013.

item.title: Os Tribunais de Contas são indispensáveis?
item.description: Constitutional Amendment 139/2026 establishes the essentiality and permanence of Courts of Accounts, prohibiting their extinction, creation, or installation, reinforcing their irreplaceable role in external public administration control. This change addresses the gap identified by the STF in ADI 5763-CE and aligns the Courts of Accounts with the constitutional treatment reserved for the Public Prosecutor's Office and Public Defender's Office, ensuring their independence and functional exclusivity.

item.title: Ciro Gomes lança pré-candidatura ao governo do Ceará após descartar disputa ao Planalto
item.description: Ciro Gomes launched his pre-candidacy for governor of Ceará under the PSDB, after ruling out a presidential run, with Roberto Claudio as his running mate. He leads in polls against current governor Elmano de Freitas (PT), but trails Camilo Santana in simulations. The race is marked by a family split, as his brother Cid Gomes (PSB) backs the PT-led ticket.

item.title: Integrante do time de inteligência de Trump defende maior integração entre Brasil e EUA
item.description: Felix Lasarte, a member of Trump's Presidential Intelligence Council, advocated for stronger economic integration between Brazil and the U.S., including ending visa requirements, following a meeting between Trump and Lula at the White House. The Planalto Palace expects deeper bilateral alignment in the coming months.

item.title: Lula acumula recuos após desgaste político no 3º mandato
item.description: Lula’s government has accumulated policy reversals since the start of his third term, including attempts to end the FGTS birthday withdrawal and remove gender and social name fields from the new ID card, due to political, social, or market pressure. While the administration attributes criticism to disinformation and opposition attacks, allies acknowledge internal missteps in communication and impact assessment.

item.title: Flávio volta a dizer que classificará PCC e CV como “terroristas”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a presidential pre-candidate, reiterated that if elected, he would classify the PCC and Comando Vermelho as 'terrorist organizations', a stance he previously defended in March. The statement was made during the launch of federal deputy Guilherme Derrite's (PP-SP) Senate pre-candidacy in Sorocaba, where São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas canceled attendance due to a sore throat. The federal government opposes the labeling, citing risks to national sovereignty and criminal code complications.

item.title: Guilherme Derrite lança pré-candidatura ao Senado por SP durante evento com Flávio Bolsonaro em Sorocaba
item.description: Guilherme Derrite (PP) announced his pre-candidacy for the São Paulo Senate seat at an event in Sorocaba alongside Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), pre-candidate for president. Derrite criticized the Workers' Party (PT), labeled criminal factions as terrorist organizations, and expressed support for establishing a parliamentary inquiry (CPI) into the Banco Master case. Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' absence was attributed to health reasons.

item.title: Tarcísio não comparece a evento com Flávio Bolsonaro por causa de gripe, segundo assessoria
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas did not attend the second event launching the Senate pre-candidacy of federal deputy Guilherme Derrite in Sorocaba due to having the flu and losing his voice, according to his office.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula e Flávio lideram rejeição com 47% e 43%; Zema tem 15% e Caiado 13%
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) lead in rejection among presidential candidates, with 47% and 43%, respectively, according to a Datafolha poll released on October 16. The figures remain stable compared to the April survey, when Lula had 48% and Flávio 46% rejection rates.

item.title: Em evento da direita em SP sem Tarcísio, Flávio diz que estão tentando ‘enterrá-lo vivo’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro accused the Lula government of a 'all-or-nothing' campaign to 'bury him alive', citing Federal Police operations against allies and the scandal involving money requests to Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master. He attended events in Sorocaba and Campinas to support Guilherme Derrite's Senate pre-candidacy, without Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, who stayed home due to a cold. Despite the governor's absence, Flávio defended his innocence and denounced the alleged politicization of the Federal Police by the federal government.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que tentaram enterrá-lo vivo e compara Lula ao diabo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) claimed his opponents underestimate him, reaffirmed his 2026 presidential pre-candidacy, and framed the upcoming election as a battle between God and the devil, associating Lula with the devil. He said adversaries tried to 'bury him alive' politically, but he remains steadfast in the race.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula vai melhor no 2º turno entre os católicos; Flávio, entre os evangélicos
item.description: Datafolha poll shows a technical tie between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 45% each in a hypothetical 2026 presidential runoff. Lula leads among women, older voters, less educated, low-income, students, Northeasterners, Black voters, and Catholics; Flávio leads among men, voters aged 25-34, higher educated, high-income earners, business owners, Evangelicals, and Southern residents. Most interviews were conducted before the disclosure of Flávio’s conversations with banker Daniel Vorcaro regarding funds for a Bolsonaro propaganda film.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro ameaça fazer do Brasil um grande governo do Rio de Janeiro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the prolonged state of decadence in Rio de Janeiro’s government, which he claims has lasted about 45 years, affecting the Executive, Legislative, and Judicial branches. He suggested that his leadership could transform the state into a model of effective governance, signaling political ambition to renew Rio’s administrative and political landscape.

item.title: As intenções de voto de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno, em novo Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on May 16, 2026 shows a technical tie between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in a hypothetical runoff, with 45% of voting intentions each. Blank and null votes total 9%, and 1% did not respond. Most interviews were conducted before the disclosure of conversations between Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro regarding the funding of the film 'Dark Horse'.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam em 2º turno, aponta Datafolha
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are tied at 45% each in a potential second round of the 2026 presidential election, according to a Datafolha poll conducted between May 12 and 13. The survey was released on Saturday, May 16, and took place prior to the disclosure of conversations between officials, which were not detailed in the provided excerpt.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula e Flávio empatados no 2º turno até o caso “Dark Horse”
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on May 16, 2026 shows a technical tie between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in a potential second-round runoff, each at 45%. Conducted May 12–13 — prior to the audio leak about financing the film 'Dark Horse' — the survey also found 9% blank/null votes and 1% undecided, with a 2-point margin of error.

item.title: Datafolha 2º turno: Lula e Flávio têm 45% das intenções de voto
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are tied at 45% each in the presidential runoff according to a Datafolha poll released this Saturday. The survey was conducted between November 12 and 13, before the revelations about Bolsonaro’s ties to Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, so it may not fully reflect the scandal’s impact. In April, Bolsonaro led with 46% versus Lula’s 45%, suggesting a slight decline in his support.

item.title: Ainda sem efeito Master, Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam no 2º turno, aponta Datafolha
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows a technical tie between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 presidential runoff, both at 45% with a two-point margin of error. The survey was conducted before the controversy involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Banco Master over the 'Dark Horse' film financing. Lula holds a clear lead over other potential opponents such as Romeu Zema and Ronaldo Caiado.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 38%, e Flávio, 35% das intenções de voto no 1º turno
item.description: Lula maintains a lead with 38% voting intentions, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 35%, according to a Datafolha poll released this Saturday. Most interviews were conducted before the revelation of conversations between Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master regarding funding for a film about Jair Bolsonaro. Other candidates Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema each have 3%, while Renan Santos reaches 2%.

item.title: PL lidera em candidatos competitivos para governador, dizem pesquisas
item.description: The PL leads in the number of competitive gubernatorial pre-candidates, with 9 names in first place or technically tied in the latest TSE polls, followed by the PSD with 6. Despite having 11 state-level slates, the PT only has 2 competitive candidates, highlighting a stronger right-wing presence in state races four months ahead of the general elections.

item.title: Petista de carteirinha, ex-secretário de Marta Suplicy assume diálogo do governo com o Congresso
item.description: Gerson Bittencourt, a lifelong PT member and former secretary under Marta Suplicy, assumes the Government Parliamentary Affairs Secretariat in Lula’s administration, replacing André Ceciliano. The role is pivotal for congressional relations amid Senate tensions over STF nominations and the overturned veto on the Dosimetria bill. Bittencourt, a former state deputy and agronomist, brings deep political experience and previously coordinated strategy for Reginaldo Lopes’ 2002 campaign.

item.title: O receio do ‘efeito Orloff’ do caso Master no Supremo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro defended Senator Ciro Nogueira, claiming Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, rapporteur of the Banco Master case, would not 'screw him over'. Hours later, an audio leak revealed he was demanding overdue payments from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, to fund the film 'Dark Horse' about his father, raising suspicions of political quid pro quo. The 'Orloff effect' describes the irony of his reassuring statements being immediately contradicted by evidence of potential wrongdoing.

item.title: Ex-presidente do STF, Joaquim Barbosa se filia ao DC e passa a ser cotado à Presidência
item.description: Former STF president Joaquim Barbosa joined the Christian Democracy (DC) party in early April 2025 and is being mentioned as a potential presidential candidate for 2026, though he has not yet confirmed his intentions. The party, which lacks congressional representation and thus has no access to TV time or debate participation, has framed its campaign around public ethics, ending privileges, and judiciary reform. The ticket remains undecided, as Aldo Rebelo launched a competing pre-candidacy in January that has failed to gain traction in recent polls.

item.title: Rinha de zumbis presidenciais
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is portrayed as a problematic presidential candidate since being chosen by his father, Jair Bolsonaro, to represent the family in the December 2025 elections. He has seen growth in voting intention polls with little effort, benefiting from the wear and tear of President Lula, whose government is depicted as unable to legitimize his election. The text suggests an electoral race marked by Bolsonarist figures and criticism of the current administration.

item.title: Joaquim Barbosa se filia ao DC e deve disputar a Presidência da República
item.description: Former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa has joined the Christian Democracy (DC) party and is expected to run for President of Brazil in 2026. The party, which previously nominated former minister Aldo Rebelo as its presidential pre-candidate, switched to Barbosa after weak polling results. Barbosa, who retired from the STF in 2014 and was mentioned as a potential candidate in 2018, is portrayed by the party leader as the figure capable of resolving Brazil’s institutional crisis among the three powers.

item.title: DC prepara retirada de Aldo Rebelo e quer lançar Joaquim Barbosa à Presidência
item.description: The Christian Democracy party plans to withdraw Aldo Rebelo's pre-candidacy to support former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa's presidential bid in 2026, after a poll showed Rebelo failed to reach 1% voting intention. The party believes Barbosa has greater electoral potential and willingness to run, hoping Rebelo will accept the decision and endorse the new candidacy.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro, o irmão Vorcaro e a máxima de que não há almoço de graça
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, is under investigation for requesting financial help from Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master and central figure in one of Brazil's largest banking frauds, claiming the funds were for a private film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The Federal Police are probing whether the money was used to support the expelled deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro in the U.S., which Flávio denies. The case illustrates how private donations can be used to buy influence, even when legally permitted, highlighting the thin line between legitimate support and corruption.

item.title: O impasse sobre a extradição de chileno condenado por estelionato, após aval do STF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes denied the defense's request to replace preventive imprisonment with house arrest for Chilean citizen Hernan Herrera Acevedo, convicted of fraud in a pyramid scheme, despite his rectal cancer treatment. Extradition was approved by the STF's First Chamber in December 2025 but awaits President Lula's decision. Moraes ordered the Justice Ministry and Itamaraty to provide updates on diplomatic proceedings.

item.title: Homens são retirados à força de evento com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Two men were forcibly removed from the launch event of Guilherme Derrite's Senate pre-candidacy in Campinas, SP, attended by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The individuals, identified as André Cardoso and Gabriel Sesonelli, reported being assaulted by event security. The incident occurred on Friday, the 15th, during the campaign launch ceremony.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se encontra com Simone Marquetto, uma das cotadas para ser sua vice
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) met with federal deputy Simone Marquetto (PP-SP), who is being considered as his potential running mate for the 2026 election, during the launch of Guilherme Derrite's (PP-SP) pre-candidacy for the Senate in São Paulo. The meeting also included federal deputy Maurício Neves, state president of the PP in SP. The gathering highlights ongoing coordination between Bolsonaro allies and the PP to strengthen a potential majoritarian ticket.

item.title: Joaquim Barbosa é ‘inapoiável’, diz dirigente do DC
item.description: Cândido Vaccarezza, president of the São Paulo directory of the Christian Democracy party (DC), declared that former STF minister Joaquim Barbosa is 'un-supportable' and said he will act to block Barbosa's potential presidential candidacy. Vaccarezza accused Barbosa of initiating 'lawfare' in Brazil, lacking commitment to democracy, and having no political experience.

item.title: Trackings mostram efeito desastroso para Flávio de sua ligação com Vorcaro
item.description: Tracking polls commissioned by a major bank and accessed by the Lula government show a disastrous impact on Flávio Bolsonaro’s image due to his close ties with businessman Daniel Vorcaro. The survey measured the electoral fallout from the revelation of this relationship, indicating strong voter rejection. The content is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Negacionismo fez brasileiros ‘perderem’ 3,4 anos de vida na pandemia
item.description: Brazil's life expectancy dropped by 3.4 years during the Covid-19 pandemic, according to the Global Burden of Disease Study, due to a 27.6% increase in mortality. Researchers attribute this setback to the negationist stance of the federal government under Jair Bolsonaro, which rejected scientific guidance, promoted ineffective treatments, and delayed vaccine acquisition. The hardest-hit states were in the North (Rondônia: 6.01 years), while the Northeast saw smaller declines due to coordinated state-level public health measures.

item.title: A dobradinha da Esplanada que vem chamando atenção de Lula e ministros
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan and Planning Minister Bruno Moretti maintain a close alignment in Lula's economic team, speaking dozens of times a day and attending joint agendas, including with the president. Their harmony is praised by Lula and other Esplanade aides, contrasting with occasional tensions between their predecessors, Fernando Haddad and Simonet Tebet.

item.title: Jim Caviezel, Bolsonaro, Melania e os nichos de filmes de direita
item.description: The financing of the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro starring Jim Caviezel and directed by Cyrus Nowrasteh, remains unclear. With a planned release in September 2026, the film has sparked debate over the role of cinematic productions in shaping right-wing political narratives in Brazil.

item.title: PGR salva semana terrível para a direita
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet accused Minas Gerais Governor Romeu Zema of defamation over a video featuring puppet-like characters resembling the Muppets or the 'Cabaré do Barata,' triggering a Streisand effect that amplified the video’s reach. The move, seen as disproportionate by analysts, backfired by drawing more attention to the content and inviting criticism that the right is overreacting to satire.

item.title: Malafaia defende Flávio: “Não recebeu nenhuma grana pessoalmente”
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia defended Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) following new allegations about the financing of the film 'Dark Horse', stating that the pre-candidate for president did not receive personal funds from the project. Malafaia said he would not make a 'value judgment' based on the revelations, maintaining his support for Bolsonaro's son.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio pede apuração de vazamento de conversa com Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign requested that Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça investigate the leak of conversations between the pre-candidate and former banker Daniel Vorcaro, revealed by Intercept Brasil. The request was made by Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), coordinator of the presidential campaign. The initiative aims to identify responsibility for the unauthorized disclosure of private messages.

item.title: Sessões de cinema e fotos de Flávio com pré-candidatos antes de áudio a Vorcaro envelhecem mal
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attended a photo session with pre-candidates in Florianópolis, featuring reserved space and excited allies eager to meet 'Zero Um'. The event reportedly took place before an audio involving Vorcaro that later aged poorly. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.
